tone.target: clean chiming chorus guitar with short ambient reverb
tone.profile: clean chiming chorus guitar with short ambient reverb
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain emphasizing clarity and shimmer: Gate -> Boost -> Chorus -> US Deluxe -> UK Vintage 4x12 -> Guitar EQ 1 -> Plate -> Volume.
corrections: keep it cleaner and less poppy
favor subtle chorus over heavy modulation

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly lift the signal and enhance high-end clarity for jangle.
blocks.gap: Using Boost to simulate a clean boost pedal (e.g., Klon/Transparent).

blocks.purpose: Create the signature chiming, shimmering chorus effect.
Select a clean, bright amp model (simulating Fender/Twin Reverb tone).
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best choice for this clean sound, but since it's listed under AMP, I will use 'None' here and rely on the dedicated AMP block.

blocks.purpose: Provide the bright, clean foundation tone.
Shape the tone with a classic, articulate cabinet sound.
blocks.gap: While US 2x12 might be more accurate for Fender tones, UK Vintage 4x12 offers good clarity and versatility in this context.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the high-end chime and cut unnecessary low frequencies.
Add the required short, ambient shimmer and depth.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better match the clean, chimey Fender-style tones.

proposals.reason: Better captures the bright, articulate sound of a single-coil guitar and clean amp.
